name: game-voice
description: Spoken captions for the games in ~/games: every text a story's card shows (its line, question, "more" paragraphs and the green or red hint after an answer) spoken by a local text-to-speech model (ollama phonon, voice Preston), one Opus clip per text keyed by the text, in one kind "voice" package per game; runtime numbers filled in from a play-through of the story or inferred from the beat's context.
